description:
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION - SALEM COUNTY
DOCKET NO.
F-006124-26
SHERIFF NO.
26000318
PLAINTIFF -
First National Bank of Elmer
DEFENDANT -
Samuel F. Parks a/k/a Samuel Parks; Patricia A. Parks a/k/a Patricia Parks; Riggins Inc.; State of New Jersey
By virtue of a Writ of Execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public venue at the Salem County Courthouse, situated at No. 92 Market Street, in the City of Salem, New Jersey on
Monday,
December 14, 2026
at
2 o’clock
in the afternoon, ALL the following lot, tract or parcel of land and premises, situate, lying and being in the Township of Pittsgrove, in the County of Salem and State of New Jersey, bounded and described as follows:
PROPERTY 1:
Municipality: Pittsgrove
County of Salem
State of New Jersey
Street and Street No.: 247 Buck Road Pittsgrove, NJ 08318
Tax Block and Lot No.: Block 103 fka 2, Lot 25 fka 11
Dimensions of Lot (approximately): 300' x 25' x 480.11' x 75' x 780' x 150'
Nearest Cross Street: Approximately 2,690.38 feet to the corner of Willow Grove Road and Buck Road.
PROPERTY 2:
Municipality: Upper Pittsgrove
County of Salem
State of New Jersey
Street and Street No.: 288 Route 40 Upper Pittsgrove, NJ 08318
Tax Block and Lot No.: Block 5 fka 20, Lot 64 fka 31
Dimensions of Lot (approximately): 187' x 60' x 294.09' x 215.57' x 350'
Nearest Cross Street: Approximately 96.08 feet to the corner of Buck Road and Route 40.
PROPERTY 3:
Municipality: Upper Pittsgrove
County of Salem
State of New Jersey
Street and Street No.: 290 Route 40 Upper Pittsgrove, NJ 08318
Tax Block and Lot No.: Block 5 fka 20, Lot 65 fka 30
Dimensions of Lot (approximately): 67.75' x 300' x 117.93' x 294.04' x 96.08'
Nearest Cross Street: On the corner of Route 40 and Buck Road.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the offices of the County Clerk and the Sheriff of Salem County.
The approximate amount of the judgment to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of $390,972.84 together with the costs of this sale.
The approximate upset price is $416,000.00 as of December 14, 2026.
The upset price may be subject to further Orders of additional sums.
This is a Commercial Foreclosure.
Please be advised that it is unknown whether the property is vacant or occupied.
The properties described in the Writ of Execution cannot be divided and should be sold as a single tract.
Pursuant to N.J.S.A. 2A:50-64, et seq., Plaintiff sets the upset bid for the foreclosed premises at the judgment amount ($416,000.00) plus all post-judgment interest as accruing through the date of the Sheriff's sale and reserves its rights with respect to any post-judgment motion for an order for additional sums, if procured following the date of the scheduling of the sale.
Terms of Sale: 20% of bid in cash, certified check or cashiers check from the successful bidder upon conclusion of sale. The Sheriff’s Office cash limit is $1,000.00 The balance is due within 30 days of the date of sale.
Surplus Money:
If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to the Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person’s claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The Sheriff reserves the right to adjourn the sale without further notice through publication.
Eisenberg, Gold & Agrawal P.C.
, Attorneys for Plaintiff
Charles M. Miller, Sheriff
